mapper.insert:
insert into Con_Boq_Dtl (Boqd_Id, Boqd_Code, Boqd_Name, Boqd_Feature, Boqd_Content, Boqd_Unit, Boqd_Amount, Boqd_Price, Boqd_Total_Price, Boqd_Remark, Boqd_State, Boqd_Parent_Id, Boqd_Sort, Boqd_Bdd_Id, Boqd_Create_Uid, Boqd_Create_Uname, Boqd_Create_Time, Boqd_Update_Time, Boq_Id, Boqd_Type, Boqd_Provisional_Estimate, Boqd_Rate, Boqd_Jsgz, Boqd_Rgf, Boqd_Zcf, Boqd_Sbf, Boqd_Fcf, Boqd_Clf, Boqd_Jxf, Boqd_Glf, Boqd_Lr, Boqd_Zgr, Boqd_Rcjhl, Boqd_Rcj_Id, Boqd_Fxxs, Boqd_Xh, Boqd_Aqsg, Boqd_Gf, Boqd_Jsjc, Boqd_Qfjs, Boqd_Jz_Dj, Boqd_Tb_Dj, Boqd_Formula, Boqd_Fees_Ratio, Boqd_Other_Ratio, Boqd_Taxes_Ratio, page_type, Boqd_Change_Pre_Id) values
( #{item.boqdId}, #{item.boqdCode}, #{item.boqdName}, #{item.boqdFeature}, #{item.boqdContent}, #{item.boqdUnit}, #{item.boqdAmount}, #{item.boqdPrice}, #{item.boqdTotalPrice}, #{item.boqdRemark}, #{item.boqdState}, #{item.boqdParentId}, #{item.boqdSort}, #{item.boqdBddId}, #{item.boqdCreateUid}, #{item.boqdCreateUname}, #{item.boqdCreateTime}, #{item.boqdUpdateTime}, #{item.boqId}, #{item.boqdType}, #{item.boqdProvisionalEstimate}, #{item.boqdRate}, #{item.boqdJsgz}, #{item.boqdRgf}, #{item.boqdZcf}, #{item.boqdSbf}, #{item.boqdFcf}, #{item.boqdClf}, #{item.boqdJxf}, #{item.boqdGlf}, #{item.boqdLr}, #{item.boqdZgr}, #{item.boqdRcjhl}, #{item.boqdRcjId}, #{item.boqdFxxs}, #{item.boqdXh}, #{item.boqdAqsg}, #{item.boqdGf}, #{item.boqdJsjc}, #{item.boqdQfjs}, #{item.boqdJzDj}, #{item.boqdTbDj}, #{item.boqdFormula}, #{item.boqdFeesRatio}, #{item.boqdOtherRatio}, #{item.boqdTaxesRatio}, #{item.pageType}, #{item.boqdChangePreId} )
mapper.select: select mn.*, boqp.Boqd_Name as boqdParentName, bdd.Bdd_Name as bddName from Con_Boq_Dtl mn left join Con_Boq_Dtl boqp on boqp.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Parent_Id left join Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl bdd on mn.Boqd_Bdd_Id = bdd.Bdd_Id left join Con_Boq cb on cb.Boq_Id=mn.Boq_Id where cb.Con_Id=#{conId} and mn.Boqd_Code=#{boqdCode} order by mn.Boqd_Sort asc
select mn.*, bdd.Bdd_Name as bddName from Con_Boq_Dtl mn left join Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl bdd on mn.Boqd_Bdd_Id = bdd.Bdd_Id where mn.Boq_Id=#{boqId} order by mn.Boqd_Sort asc

select mn.*, bdd.Bdd_Name as bddName from Con_Boq_Dtl mn left join Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl bdd on mn.Boqd_Bdd_Id = bdd.Bdd_Id where mn.Boq_Id=#{boqId} and mn.boqd_parent_id=#{parentId} order by mn.Boqd_Sort asc

select mn.Boqd_Id as boqdId, bdd.Bdd_Name as bddName, (case when mn.Boqd_Type='06' or mn.Boqd_Type='07' then 0 else (select count(*) from Con_Boq_Dtl cc where cc.Boqd_Parent_Id=mn.Boqd_Id) end ) as childDtlNum,
(case when mn.Boqd_Type='06' or mn.Boqd_Type='07' then 0 else (select count(*) from Con_Measure_Record cc where cc.Mea_Id=#{params.meaId} and cc.State!=3 and cc.Boqd_Id in (select Boqd_Id from Con_Boq_Dtl cbd where cbd.Boqd_Parent_Id=mn.Boqd_Id)) end ) as fillingNum, (case when mn.Boqd_Type='06' or mn.Boqd_Type='07' then 0 else (select count(*) from Con_Measure_Record cc where cc.Mea_Id=#{params.meaId} and cc.State=7 and cc.Boqd_Id in (select Boqd_Id from Con_Boq_Dtl cbd where cbd.Boqd_Parent_Id=mn.Boqd_Id)) end ) as approvedNum,
pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, c1.C_Name as mearContName, mn.Boqd_Amount as mearBoqdAmount, (select count(*) from Con_Measure_Record_Check rc where rc.Mear_Id=cmr.id) as recordCheckNum, cmr.*, (case when cmr.mear_Upper_Amount is not null then cmr.mear_Upper_Amount else (select sum(mear.Mear_Final_Amount) from Con_Measure_Record mear left join Con_Measure cmea on cmea.Id=mear.Mea_Id where cmea.state=7 and cmea.con_id=con.con_id and mear.state=7 and mear.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id and cmea.id!=#{params.meaId}) end) as mearUpperAmount, (case when cmr.Mear_Upper_Total is not null then cmr.Mear_Upper_Total else (select sum(mear.Mear_Final_Total) from Con_Measure_Record mear left join Con_Measure cmea on cmea.Id=mear.Mea_Id where cmea.state=7 and cmea.con_id=con.con_id and mear.state=7 and mear.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id and cmea.id!=#{params.meaId}) end) as mearUpperTotal,
mn.* from Con_Boq_Dtl mn left join Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl bdd on mn.Boqd_Bdd_Id = bdd.Bdd_Id left join Con_Boq cb on cb.Boq_Id=mn.Boq_Id
left join Con_Measure_Record cmr on cmr.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Id and cmr.Mea_Id=#{params.meaId} left join Con_Measure cm on cm.Id=cmr.Mea_Id and cm.State!=3 left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = cmr.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = cmr.P_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = cmr.Mear_Contractor_Id
cb.Con_Id=#{params.conId} and cb.Boq_State=7 and (mn.page_type!='03' or mn.page_type is NULL)
and cmr.Mea_Id=#{params.meaId} and cmr.State!=3
and mn.Boqd_Parent_Id=#{params.boqdParentId}
and (mn.Boqd_Type='06' or mn.Boqd_Type='07')
and mn.Boqd_Type!='06' and mn.Boqd_Type!='07'
order by mn.Boqd_Sort asc

select boqp.Boqd_Name as boqdParentName, mn.* from Con_Boq_Dtl mn left join Con_Boq boq on mn.Boq_Id = boq.Boq_Id left join Con_Boq_Dtl boqp on boqp.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Parent_Id where boq.Con_Id=#{conId} and boq.Boq_State=7 and (mn.page_type!='03' or mn.page_type is NULL) order by mn.Boqd_Sort asc

select boqp.Boqd_Name as boqdParentName, mn.* from Con_Boq_Dtl mn left join Con_Boq boq on mn.Boq_Id = boq.Boq_Id left join Con_Boq_Dtl boqp on boqp.Boqd_Id=mn.Boqd_Parent_Id where boq.Con_Id=#{conId} and boq.Boq_State=7 order by mn.Boqd_Sort asc
